▌ New Season Content Overview

■ All-New Season Gameplay: Escapade
● At the start of each match, a voyage companion from Fluffy Across the Blue will be randomly revealed to the Trailblazer. The voyage companion randomly applies a special effect, providing buffs for that match.
● Each voyage companion has a distinct comic look and buff specialty, like chapters from different comic styles: some favor gear, some excel at resource supply, and some will bring unexpected changes to your Nodes.

■ All-New Season Gameplay: "Plot Armor"
● Before the boss battles in Planes 1 and 2, the Trailblazer can select one employee on the field to become this battle's "protagonist," granting them the powerful Plot Armor effect.
● Plot Armor comes with a variety of effects, including but not limited to: character buffs (various combat enhancements, unique exclusive mechanics); Bond buffs (Bond-exclusive enhancements, gaining additional Bonds, etc.); and resource provisions (temporary equipment, economic resources).
